description: This file defines API routes for managing notes in a web application using FastAPI and SQLAlchemy. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, deleting notes, and listing note history. The code involves filtering, pagination, and transaction management for notes and their history.

methods.name: _apply_search_filters(query, search: Optional[str], tags: Optional[List[str]])

methods.description: Lists notes with pagination, optional search text and tags filtering.

methods.name: NoteOut create_note(payload: NoteCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Creates a new note and logs its initial history.

methods.name: NoteOut get_note(note_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID.

methods.name: NoteOut update_note(note_id: int, payload: NoteUpdate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Updates an existing note, saving its previous state in history.

methods.name: None delete_note(note_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.

methods.name: List[NoteHistoryOut] list_note_history(note_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Lists historical snapshots of a note.
